title: Nutty Chewy Middle Eastern Almond Cookies
description: Sweet, bouncy cookies that combine almond flour, pomegranate molasses, and tempered dark chocolate for a keto-friendly hangover cure.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk almond flour, coconut flour, erythritol, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
Add melted coconut oil, egg, and vanilla to the dry mix; stir until a sticky dough forms.
Fold in slivered almonds and pomegranate molasses until evenly distributed.
Scoop dough onto the prepared sheet with a tablespoon, spacing 2 inches apart.
Bake for 12 to 14 minutes until edges are golden and centers set.
Cool the cookies on the sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to finish cooling.
Chop the dark chocolate into small pieces and melt it in a double boiler or microwave, stirring every 30 seconds.
Stir in a teaspoon of pomegranate molasses into the melted chocolate and drizzle the glaze over the cooled cookies.
Allow the chocolate glaze to set before serving.
